display_text: A Mysterious Effect - can be any one of these 4 sets: ** [[Dexterity| Dexterity +3]] and [[Resistance (enchantment)| Resistance +3]][[Resistance (enchantment)| Resistance +3]]: Passive: +3 [[Resistance bonus]] to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws. ** [[Charisma| Charisma +3]][[Charisma| Charisma +3]]: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +3 [[Enhancement bonus]] to Charisma. and [[Fortification|Fortification +75%]][[Fortification|Fortification +75%]]: +75% [[Enhancement bonus]] to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit. ** [[Strength| Strength +3]][[Strength| Strength +3]]: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +3 [[Enhancement bonus]] to Strength. and [[Protection|Protection +3]][[Protection|Protection +3]]: Passive: +3 [[Deflection bonus]] to [[Armor Class]]. ** [[Constitution| Constitution +3]][[Constitution| Constitution +3]]: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +3 [[Enhancement bonus]] to Constitution. and [[Spell penetration| Spell Penetration I]][[Spell penetration| Spell Penetration I]]: Passive: +1 [[Equipment bonus]] to Spell Penetration checks.
